reading_benefit_hypothesis: One traversal and one binding reconstruction make metadata retention and identity selection common; the public wrappers show only how the known term is built. Closed template arguments avoid runtime closure duplication.

tradeoff: Introduces one generic template and an explicit payload parameter; parent must judge whether centralizing the invariant outweighs that indirection. No reading target or performance improvement is claimed.
